# Antigravity Design System

> An agent-native, human-centric design system built at the intersection of visual precision, physical intuition, and rigorous engineering. Powered by React 19, Base UI, Motion, and Tailwind CSS v4.

## Progressive Agent Retrieval

- **Component Index**: Read `public/registry.json` or `public/llms.txt` first, then open only the required `public/docs/components/<slug>.md` manuals.
- **Local MCP Server**: Run `npm run mcp` for tool-based `recommend_components`, `get_component_spec`, `search_icons`, and `validate_snippet` queries.

## Component Selection Decision Matrix

| Task / UI Intent | Primary Choice | Avoid Confusing With | Building-Block Spec |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Destructive confirmation modal | `AlertDialog` | `Dialog` | `public/docs/components/alert-dialog.md` |
| Standard secondary form modal | `Dialog` | `AlertDialog`, `Sheet` | `public/docs/components/dialog.md` |
| Slide-over inspector or settings panel | `Sheet` | `Drawer`, `Dialog` | `public/docs/components/sheet.md` |
| Compact 2 to 5 option view switcher | `SegmentedControl` | `Tabs`, `Select` | `public/docs/components/segmented-control.md` |
| Multi-panel horizontal tab sections | `Tabs` | `SegmentedControl` | `public/docs/components/tabs.md` |
| Searchable large option list | `Combobox` | `Select`, `Command` | `public/docs/components/combobox.md` |
| Global `⌘K` action palette | `Command` | `Combobox` | `public/docs/components/command.md` |
| Immediate live boolean setting | `Switch` | `Checkbox`, `Toggle` | `public/docs/components/switch.md` |
| Validated form input wrapper | `Field` | `Callout` | `public/docs/components/field.md` |
| Operational status / count chip | `Badge` | `Callout` | `public/docs/components/badge.md` |
| Design invariant / warning callout | `Callout` | `Badge`, `Toast` | `public/docs/components/callout.md` |
| Runnable UI fixture with Code view | `ComponentPreview` | `CodeBlock` | `public/docs/components/component-preview.md` |
| Documentation shell & scroll-spy TOC | `DocLayout` | `NavigationBar` | `public/docs/components/doc-layout.md` |

## Core Architectural Directives (18 Rules)

- [Directive 1: Physical Yield on pointerdown](file:///AGENTS.md): Interactive controls compress to scale 0.97-0.98 immediately on pointerdown.
- [Directive 2: Zero Layout Shifts](file:///AGENTS.md): Never change border-width, font-weight, tracking, padding, or margin on hover/focus/active.
- [Directive 3: Tabular Numerals](file:///AGENTS.md): Counters, prices, metrics, and line numbers declare tabular-nums.
- [Directive 4: Accessible Invariants](file:///AGENTS.md): Every icon-only button carries an explicit aria-label; modals trap focus and dismiss on Escape.
- [Directive 5: Quiet Chrome & Anti-Pill](file:///AGENTS.md): Avoid reflexive bordered card grids and decorative eyebrow pills above headings.
- [Directive 6: Concentric Corner Radii](file:///AGENTS.md): Nested corners obey R_inner = max(0, R_outer - Padding).
- [Directive 7: Anti-Crush Architecture](file:///AGENTS.md): Declare explicit page archetypes, W_col >= 340px, and shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap pills.
- [Directive 8: Reversible Kinetic Affordances](file:///AGENTS.md): Icons animate along mechanical paths that return cleanly to rest on pointer leave.
- [Directive 9: Component Dimension Invariants](file:///AGENTS.md): Never override h-*/w-* variants with trailing size-full or size-auto inside cn().
- [Directive 10: Optical Icon Proportion](file:///AGENTS.md): Pass explicit numeric size={...} matching 40% to 50% of parent height.
- [Directive 11: Perceptual OKLCH & Dual Contrast](file:///AGENTS.md): Gradients interpolate in oklch with WCAG 2.2 AA and WCAG 3 APCA contrast floors.
- [Directive 12: British English & Clean Prose](file:///AGENTS.md): Zero AI em dashes, zero banned marketing buzzwords, strict British English spelling.
- [Directive 13: Origin Anonymity](file:///AGENTS.md): Present all guidelines, tokens, and components as self-contained standards of this system.
- [Directive 14: Telemetry Indicator Cadence](file:///AGENTS.md): Pulse animations rest >= 60% of cycle at opacity 0 and animate compositor properties only.
- [Directive 15: Brand Truth & Fact Integrity](file:///AGENTS.md): Never invent synthetic metrics, fake testimonials, or unverified brand hex colours.
- [Directive 16: Micro-Finish & Baseline Stability](file:///AGENTS.md): Reserve min-h-[1lh] for form helper/error slots and cap containers at 1440px.
- [Directive 17: Evidence Before Assertions](file:///AGENTS.md): Execute empirical verification gates and confirm exit code 0 before reporting done.
- [Directive 18: Autonomous Rulings](file:///AGENTS.md): Record minor design-engineering rulings and maintain forward build velocity.

## UI Primitives Matrix (57 Components)

### Actions & Toggles (8)
- `Button` (`@/components/ui/button` | spec: `public/docs/components/button.md`): Tactile action primitive with 9 visual variants, pointerdown yield, and async promise lifecycle.
- `CopyButton` (`@/components/ui/copy-button` | spec: `public/docs/components/copy-button.md`): Clipboard action control with spring state transition feedback.
- `MarkdownToolbar` (`@/components/ui/markdown-toolbar` | spec: `public/docs/components/markdown-toolbar.md`): Rich Markdown formatting toolbar with 20 actions and list/table generators.
- `SegmentedControl` (`@/components/ui/segmented-control` | spec: `public/docs/components/segmented-control.md`): Sliding pill mode switcher with compositor spring glide and frozen text metrics.
- `ThemeToggle` (`@/components/ui/theme-toggle` | spec: `public/docs/components/theme-toggle.md`): Instant light/dark switcher suppressing cross-theme transition flashes.
- `Toggle` (`@/components/ui/toggle` | spec: `public/docs/components/toggle.md`): Two-state pressed action button adhering to zero-shift geometry.
- `ToggleGroup` (`@/components/ui/toggle-group` | spec: `public/docs/components/toggle-group.md`): Grouped toggle toolbar supporting single and multi-select roving focus.
- `Toolbar` (`@/components/ui/toolbar` | spec: `public/docs/components/toolbar.md`): Compound desktop toolbar housing aligned button groups and separators.

### Forms & Input (12)
- `Checkbox` (`@/components/ui/checkbox` | spec: `public/docs/components/checkbox.md`): Tri-state accessible checkbox with 44px touch hit target expansion.
- `Combobox` (`@/components/ui/combobox` | spec: `public/docs/components/combobox.md`): Searchable autocomplete selector with keyboard roving navigation.
- `Field` (`@/components/ui/field` | spec: `public/docs/components/field.md`): Compound form field wrapper coordinating labels, hints, and min-h-[1lh] error slots.
- `FileUpload` (`@/components/ui/file-upload` | spec: `public/docs/components/file-upload.md`): Drag-and-drop asset uploader with client-side validation and progress state.
- `Input` (`@/components/ui/input` | spec: `public/docs/components/input.md`): 16px iOS zoom-safe text field with specular border and prefix/suffix slots.
- `InputOTP` (`@/components/ui/input-otp` | spec: `public/docs/components/input-otp.md`): Segmented PIN code input with clipboard autofill and digit focus stepping.
- `RadioGroup` (`@/components/ui/radio-group` | spec: `public/docs/components/radio-group.md`): WAI-ARIA compliant mutual exclusion selector with animated indicator.
- `Select` (`@/components/ui/select` | spec: `public/docs/components/select.md`): Headless Base UI selector with keyboard navigation and liquid glass popup.
- `Slider` (`@/components/ui/slider` | spec: `public/docs/components/slider.md`): Direct-manipulation single and dual-thumb range control with value tooltip.
- `Stepper` (`@/components/ui/stepper` | spec: `public/docs/components/stepper.md`): Tactile numeric stepper with hold-to-accelerate progression.
- `Switch` (`@/components/ui/switch` | spec: `public/docs/components/switch.md`): 44px accessible toggle switch with fluid thumb spring easing.
- `Textarea` (`@/components/ui/textarea` | spec: `public/docs/components/textarea.md`): Multi-line text input with subtle border-hugging focus contrast.

### Navigation & Menus (4)
- `Breadcrumb` (`@/components/ui/breadcrumb` | spec: `public/docs/components/breadcrumb.md`): Hierarchical location trail with kinetic directional separators.
- `NavigationBar` (`@/components/ui/navigation-bar` | spec: `public/docs/components/navigation-bar.md`): Responsive top navigation rail with mega menus, columns, and bounded overflow harvesting.
- `Pagination` (`@/components/ui/pagination` | spec: `public/docs/components/pagination.md`): Paged collection controller with compact numeric and worded triggers.
- `Tabs` (`@/components/ui/tabs` | spec: `public/docs/components/tabs.md`): Fluid navigation tabs with spring underline indicator and zero geometry shift.

### Overlays & Surfaces (11)
- `AlertDialog` (`@/components/ui/alert-dialog` | spec: `public/docs/components/alert-dialog.md`): High-friction confirmation modal requiring explicit user acknowledgement.
- `Command` (`@/components/ui/command` | spec: `public/docs/components/command.md`): Global command palette modal with instant filtering and keycap hints.
- `ContextMenu` (`@/components/ui/context-menu` | spec: `public/docs/components/context-menu.md`): Secondary pointer context menu supporting nested groups and radio selections.
- `Dialog` (`@/components/ui/dialog` | spec: `public/docs/components/dialog.md`): Focus-trapped modal dialogue with liquid backdrop blur and Escape dismissal.
- `Drawer` (`@/components/ui/drawer` | spec: `public/docs/components/drawer.md`): Swipeable edge drawer with tactile drag handle for compact viewports.
- `DropdownMenu` (`@/components/ui/dropdown-menu` | spec: `public/docs/components/dropdown-menu.md`): Anchored menu surface with keyboard navigation, checkboxes, and shortcuts.
- `HoverCard` (`@/components/ui/hover-card` | spec: `public/docs/components/hover-card.md`): Rich contextual preview popover triggered on pointer hover or keyboard focus.
- `Popover` (`@/components/ui/popover` | spec: `public/docs/components/popover.md`): Collision-aware floating overlay anchored cleanly to its trigger.
- `Sheet` (`@/components/ui/sheet` | spec: `public/docs/components/sheet.md`): Slide-over side panel supporting top, right, bottom, and left edges.
- `Toast` (`@/components/ui/toast` | spec: `public/docs/components/toast.md`): Non-blocking feedback toast with timed auto-dismiss and undo trigger.
- `Tooltip` (`@/components/ui/tooltip` | spec: `public/docs/components/tooltip.md`): Compact contextual hint surface with configurable hover delay.

### Data & Feedback (16)
- `Accordion` (`@/components/ui/accordion` | spec: `public/docs/components/accordion.md`): Accessible vertical disclosure stack with smooth CSS height reveal.
- `Avatar` (`@/components/ui/avatar` | spec: `public/docs/components/avatar.md`): User identity emblem with deterministic OKLCH fallback and status pip.
- `Badge` (`@/components/ui/badge` | spec: `public/docs/components/badge.md`): Shrink-wrapped operational telemetry pill with optional pulse indicator.
- `Calendar` (`@/components/ui/calendar` | spec: `public/docs/components/calendar.md`): Interactive month calendar grid with spring transition paging.
- `Card` (`@/components/ui/card` | spec: `public/docs/components/card.md`): Concentric container surface with specular rim lighting and inner card nesting.
- `Chart` (`@/components/ui/chart` | spec: `public/docs/components/chart.md`): Zero-dependency OKLCH vector sparklines, area visualisations, and bar charts.
- `Image` (`@/components/ui/image` | spec: `public/docs/components/image.md`): Zero-CLS progressive media loader with smooth decoding fade.
- `Kbd` (`@/components/ui/kbd` | spec: `public/docs/components/kbd.md`): Tactile keycap micro-primitive styled with tabular monospace proportions.
- `NumberTicker` (`@/components/ui/number-ticker` | spec: `public/docs/components/number-ticker.md`): Tabular numeral spring counter preventing horizontal digit jitter.
- `Progress` (`@/components/ui/progress` | spec: `public/docs/components/progress.md`): Deterministic linear progress bar and radial gauge with smooth spring interpolation.
- `Resizable` (`@/components/ui/resizable` | spec: `public/docs/components/resizable.md`): Keyboard and drag split-pane layout controller for workbench interfaces.
- `ScrollArea` (`@/components/ui/scroll-area` | spec: `public/docs/components/scroll-area.md`): Cross-browser custom scrollbar viewport preserving layout gutter parity.
- `Skeleton` (`@/components/ui/skeleton` | spec: `public/docs/components/skeleton.md`): Zero-CLS dimensionally stable loading placeholder surface.
- `Table` (`@/components/ui/table` | spec: `public/docs/components/table.md`): Quiet chrome data table with strict tabular numerals.
- `Timeline` (`@/components/ui/timeline` | spec: `public/docs/components/timeline.md`): Chronological event feed with pulse nodes and packet connectors.
- `Tree` (`@/components/ui/tree` | spec: `public/docs/components/tree.md`): Hierarchical file and folder tree with spring expand/collapse motion.

### Documentation & Schematics (6)
- `Callout` (`@/components/ui/callout` | spec: `public/docs/components/callout.md`): Editorial admonition surface with semantic OKLCH variants including defining constraints.
- `CodeBlock` (`@/components/ui/code-block` | spec: `public/docs/components/code-block.md`): Concentric syntax viewport with tabular line numbers, line highlights, and multi-tab switcher.
- `ComponentPreview` (`@/components/ui/component-preview` | spec: `public/docs/components/component-preview.md`): Symmetric live fixture stage with preview/code switcher, viewport presets, and state reset.
- `DiagramFrame` (`@/components/ui/diagram-frame` | spec: `public/docs/components/diagram-frame.md`): Accessible orthogonal SVG schematic container with semantic caption and expanded zoom modal.
- `DocLayout` (`@/components/ui/doc-layout` | spec: `public/docs/components/doc-layout.md`): Three-column reference macrostructure with bounded sidebar, 72ch measure, and scroll-spy TOC.
- `PropTable` (`@/components/ui/prop-table` | spec: `public/docs/components/prop-table.md`): Anti-crush TypeScript API reference table displaying props, types, defaults, and required pills.

## Kinetic Icons (470 Primitives)

Access 470 mechanical animated icons in `@/components/icons`. Always pass an explicit numeric `size={...}` prop matching 40% to 50% of parent control height.

## Agent Skills (8 Registered Workflows)

- `app-blueprint` (`skills/app-blueprint/SKILL.md`): Use when building a complete application screen, multi-page product, or documented feature with this design system. Never use for single utility functions or non-UI backend scripts.
- `base-ui-primitives` (`skills/base-ui-primitives/SKILL.md`): Use when building or auditing accessible headless UI primitives with @base-ui/react, compound slots, keyboard roving navigation, focus traps, and WCAG 2.2 states.
- `craft-philosophy` (`skills/craft-philosophy/SKILL.md`): Use when designing, building, or reviewing UI components and screens. Enforces human-centric craft, 9-state interactive matrices, and anti-slop geometry.
- `diagram-architecture` (`skills/diagram-architecture/SKILL.md`): Use when designing, drawing, or auditing technical diagrams, system schematics, flowcharts, and accessible SVGs. Enforces orthogonal routing and node budgets.
- `motion-physics` (`skills/motion-physics/SKILL.md`): Use when animating UI transitions, gestures, modals, or active states with motion/react. Enforces calibrated spring physics, pointerdown yield, and velocity.
- `production-deployment` (`skills/production-deployment/SKILL.md`): Use when preparing web interfaces for production deployment. Enforces Speculation Rules, View Transitions, SWR edge caching, safe-area insets, and zero-CLS.
- `semantic-theming` (`skills/semantic-theming/SKILL.md`): Use when creating, styling, or auditing design tokens and themes. Enforces perceptual OKLCH colour spaces, Tailwind CSS v4 @theme inline, and APCA contrast.
- `technical-documentation` (`skills/technical-documentation/SKILL.md`): Use when authoring, editing, or auditing technical docs, READMEs, ADRs, changelogs, and API guides. Enforces concept grounding, active prose, and drift gates.

## Verification & Tooling Commands

- `npm run docs:build`: Regenerates docs-manifest.ts, 57 per-component markdown specs, registry.json, llms.txt, and llms-full.txt.
- `npm run docs:check`: Verifies generated documentation artifacts match current AST, ComponentSpecs, and CSS tokens.
- `npm run mcp`: Starts local stdio MCP server exposing component recommendations, specs, icon search, and snippet validation.
- `npm run check`: Executes docs:check, invariants gate, Oxlint, Vitest accessibility tests, and Vite production build.
